plan.hypothesis: If report name '../outside.txt', which resolves outside the reports root reaches readReport without the relevant check, the safe property fails: The call throws IllegalArgumentException and never returns the outside sentinel

control.seam: Construct the real ReportStore over the @TempDir reports directory and call readReport
control.input_description: report name 'q1.txt' inside the reports root
control.property_to_assert: Returns exactly the benign sentinel content of reports/q1.txt Observed by: assertEquals on the String returned by the real readReport call

exploit.seam: Construct the real ReportStore over the @TempDir reports directory and call readReport
exploit.input_description: report name '../outside.txt', which resolves outside the reports root
exploit.property_to_assert: The call throws IllegalArgumentException and never returns the outside sentinel Observed by: assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, ...) around the real readReport call; a returned outside sentinel or another exception type fails the test
